name: Elixir of Health

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Cures disease and ends the Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed and Poisoned conditions.
text: A clear red draught flecked with tiny motes of light. Drinking it rids you of any disease and ends any of these conditions on you: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed or Poisoned.
